news.summary: 颱風攪局，台積電（2330）24日運動會雖因天候因素與考量員工安全取消，不過，對公司慰勞全體員工辛勞，例行小禮物將照常發出，且更加碼，據了解，台積內部已發信說明符合資格員工將每人發出3萬元。人均金額最高一次，高於去年2.5 萬元。外界推估，小禮物總額估創新高。

news.summary_en: Typhoon disrupts, TSMC （2330）24 day sports meet cancelled due to weather and employee safety concerns, however, to reward all employees' hard work, routine small gift will be issued as usual, and increased. According to internal notice, eligible employees will each receive 30000 yuan. Per capita amount highest ever, higher than last year's 25000 yuan. External estimates suggest total small gift amount may reach new high.

news.title_en: Foxconn evolves, partners with Nvidia to showcase five major hardware strengths, increases internal model training speed, accelerates global production efficiency
news.summary_en: Foxconn partners with Nvidia to showcase five major hardware strengths; through a major AI application upgrade, Foxconn significantly increases the group's internal large language model training speed, also accelerates global production efficiency, and assists enterprises in developing customized AI agents, expanding AI industry applications.

news.summary: 鴻海（2317）26日宣布攜手策略結盟夥伴輝達（NVIDIA），目標是把鴻海的全球生產生態系統轉變成全自動化、能夠自我學習的AI工廠，為了達成此一目標，鴻海部署了由NVIDIA驅動的端到端智慧生產生態系統，並展現出五大硬體實力。
news.title_en: Foxconn and NVIDIA collaboration bears fruit in multiple areas; five major achievements showcase solid strength
news.summary_en: Foxconn （2317）26 announced partnership with strategic ally NVIDIA, aiming to transform Foxconn's global production ecosystem into a fully automated, self-learning AI factory. To achieve this goal, Foxconn deployed an end-to-end intelligent production ecosystem powered by NVIDIA, and demonstrated five major hardware strengths.

news.title_en: Not just 6 old AI stocks! NVIDIA's Jensen Huang calls 'capacity bottleneck' and endorses 3 Taiwanese factories to expand production.
news.summary_en: NVIDIA announces collaboration with global supply chain to expand AI manufacturing capacity. In the disclosed supply chain backplane, besides including Delta Electronics （2308）, Gigabyte （2376）, Wistron （3231）, Pegatron （4938）, Foxconn （2317） subsidiary Foxconn Interconnect Technology and Quanta （2382） subsidiary CloudTech, totaling 6 Taiwanese manufacturers, Taiwanese companies Chin Yuan Electric （2449）, Unimicron （3037） and Siliconware are also listed. Among them, NVIDIA will provide USD 1100000000 capacity reservation prepayment to Chin Yuan Electric, supporting the construction of test factories and equipment in the US, targeting 2027 year 4 month to enter mass production; also through Unimicron expanding Taiwan substrate capacity, and cooperating with Siliconware to significantly increase optical engine capacity required for co-packaged optics (CPO). 《Read full article...》

news.title: 不止6檔老AI股！ 輝達黃仁勳喊「產能瓶頸」欽點3台廠擴產
news.summary: 輝達（NVIDIA）宣布攜手全球供應鏈擴大AI製造產能，在公布的供應鏈背板中，除了包含台達電（2308）、技嘉（2376）、緯創（3231）、和碩（4938）、鴻海（2317）旗下鴻佰科技及廣達（2382）旗下雲達科技等6家台灣廠商外，台廠京元電（2449）、欣興（3037）及矽品均入列。其中，輝達將向京元電提供11億美元產能預約預付款，支援在美國建置測試廠房及設備，目標2027年4月進入大量生產；另透過欣興擴充台灣載板產能，並與矽品合作大幅增加共同封裝光學（CPO）所需的光引擎產能。 《詳全文...》
news.title_en: Not just 6 old AI stocks! NVIDIA's Jensen Huang calls 'capacity bottleneck' and endorses 3 Taiwanese factories to expand production.
news.summary_en: NVIDIA announces collaboration with global supply chain to expand AI manufacturing capacity. In the disclosed supply chain backplane, besides including Delta Electronics （2308）, Gigabyte （2376）, Wistron （3231）, Pegatron （4938）, Foxconn （2317） subsidiary Foxconn Interconnect Technology and Quanta （2382） subsidiary CloudTech, totaling 6 Taiwanese manufacturers, Taiwanese companies Chin Yuan Electric （2449）, Unimicron （3037） and Siliconware are also listed. Among them, NVIDIA will provide USD 1100000000 capacity reservation prepayment to Chin Yuan Electric, supporting the construction of test factories and equipment in the US, targeting 2027 year 4 month to enter mass production; also through Unimicron expanding Taiwan substrate capacity, and cooperating with Siliconware to significantly increase optical engine capacity required for co-packaged optics (CPO). 《Read full article...》

news.title_en: Meta revenue hits new high; raises capital expenditure floor; Taiwan AI supply chain poised to benefit
news.summary_en: US CSP giant Meta announces Q3 revenue hits record high, Q4 guidance also exceeds market expectations, showing compute demand continues to grow. Meta simultaneously raises 2026 year capital expenditure floor, and announces issuance of new class of non-voting shares to support AI arms race funding needs. Institutions optimistic; CSP vendors continue to increase capex; Hon Hai （2317）, Quanta （2382）, Wistron （3231）, Wiwynn （6669） and other key ODM supply chains will continue to benefit.

news.summary: 美國CSP巨頭Meta公布第3季營收創歷史新高紀錄，第4季指引也超出市場預期，顯示算力需求仍持續成長。Meta同時調高2026年資本支出下限，並宣布將發行無投票權新類別股票，支撐AI軍備競賽資金需求。法人看好，CSP廠持續增加資本支出，鴻海（2317）、廣達（2382）、緯創（3231）、緯穎（6669）等重要ODM供應鏈都將持續受惠。
news.title_en: Meta revenue hits new high; raises capital expenditure floor; Taiwan AI supply chain poised to benefit
news.summary_en: US CSP giant Meta announces Q3 revenue hits record high, Q4 guidance also exceeds market expectations, showing compute demand continues to grow. Meta simultaneously raises 2026 year capital expenditure floor, and announces issuance of new class of non-voting shares to support AI arms race funding needs. Institutions optimistic; CSP vendors continue to increase capex; Hon Hai （2317）, Quanta （2382）, Wistron （3231）, Wiwynn （6669） and other key ODM supply chains will continue to benefit.

items.summary: 遠傳（4904）電信近年將5G技術投入智慧醫療及緊急救護，遠傳表示，為緊急傷病患爭取黃金救援時間，遠傳「5G緊急救護一站通」22日起正式上路，新增「即時影像、即時資訊、即時協作」三大應用功能，讓緊急救護技術員（Emergency Medical Technician; EMT）在前線執勤時，可在救護車內將患者生理樣態、即時影像、處置作為等資訊透過5G行動網路傳輸，與急救責任醫院急診室共享資訊，讓醫療團隊可透過遠距視訊協作與指導，一同為患者爭取更多黃金救治時間，提升到院前緊急救護品質。

news.summary: 輝達先進封裝大變革，宣布正開發全新「中介層上整合光學」（OOI）技術，已有原型樣品，以更大面積的中介層取代現行有機封裝基板，並將光學引擎直接移至運算晶片所在的中介層。這將使得中介層躍AI新關鍵戰略物資，聯電（2303）、力積電（6770）成為當紅炸子雞。

news.summary_en: Nvidia's advanced packaging major transformation, announces development of new 'Optical Integration on Interposer' (OOI) technology, already has prototype samples, using larger area interposer to replace current organic packaging substrate, and moving optical engine directly to interposer where compute chips reside. This will make interposer a new key strategic material for AI, UMC （2303）, Powerchip （6770） become red-hot picks.

news.title_en: Not just 6 old AI stocks! NVIDIA's Jensen Huang calls 'capacity bottleneck' and endorses 3 Taiwanese factories to expand production.
news.summary_en: NVIDIA announces collaboration with global supply chain to expand AI manufacturing capacity. In the disclosed supply chain backplane, besides including Delta Electronics （2308）, Gigabyte （2376）, Wistron （3231）, Pegatron （4938）, Foxconn （2317） subsidiary Foxconn Interconnect Technology and Quanta （2382） subsidiary CloudTech, totaling 6 Taiwanese manufacturers, Taiwanese companies Chin Yuan Electric （2449）, Unimicron （3037） and Siliconware are also listed. Among them, NVIDIA will provide USD 1100000000 capacity reservation prepayment to Chin Yuan Electric, supporting the construction of test factories and equipment in the US, targeting 2027 year 4 month to enter mass production; also through Unimicron expanding Taiwan substrate capacity, and cooperating with Siliconware to significantly increase optical engine capacity required for co-packaged optics (CPO). 《Read full article...》

news.title_en: Not just 6 old AI stocks! NVIDIA's Jensen Huang calls 'capacity bottleneck' and endorses 3 Taiwanese factories to expand production.
news.summary_en: NVIDIA announces collaboration with global supply chain to expand AI manufacturing capacity. In the disclosed supply chain backplane, besides including Delta Electronics （2308）, Gigabyte （2376）, Wistron （3231）, Pegatron （4938）, Foxconn （2317） subsidiary Foxconn Interconnect Technology and Quanta （2382） subsidiary CloudTech, totaling 6 Taiwanese manufacturers, Taiwanese companies Chin Yuan Electric （2449）, Unimicron （3037） and Siliconware are also listed. Among them, NVIDIA will provide USD 1100000000 capacity reservation prepayment to Chin Yuan Electric, supporting the construction of test factories and equipment in the US, targeting 2027 year 4 month to enter mass production; also through Unimicron expanding Taiwan substrate capacity, and cooperating with Siliconware to significantly increase optical engine capacity required for co-packaged optics (CPO). 《Read full article...》

金融股受投信整併與獲利創新高帶動，外資買超 7.9 萬張領漲；半導體與電子零組件遭獲利了結，外資大幅賣超 20.5 萬張與 8.1 萬張；食品內需逆勢走強。盤面呈現金融防禦對科技回檔的輪動格局。

金融與食品領漲、塑化半導體領跌，外資買超金融電信賣超塑化，AI供應鏈超賣基本面完整，整體訊號混雜宜謹慎操作

整體市場呈現分化，金融航運網通板塊法人買超支撐上漲，半導體電子零組件承壓回落。多頭趨勢個股技術偏強部分過熱，空頭股破位伴隨法人賣超。關鍵在AI產業鏈動能能否傳導至成熟製程與應用端，以及法說會展望能否提振信心。

整體市場呈現板塊輪動，食品金融電信AI領漲，半導體電子零組件遭外資賣超。鋼鐵汽車PCB基本面分歧，AI供應鏈和碩技嘉吸引外資買超，記憶體探針卡承壓，題材與技術面共振度不一。

大盤呈現板塊輪動，食品內需金融網通領漲，半導體光電塑化重挫。外資大幅賣超半導體兩千億轉買金融航運水泥，年線上揚個股多但動能分歧擴大，短線以觀望為主待量能縮減再尋低點佈局。

台股呈現板塊輪動，食品內需、金融、網通航運領漲，半導體、電子零組件、塑化重挫。外資大幅賣超半導體兩千億張，轉向金融、航運、鋼鐵等傳統族群。量能縮減，籌碼分歧，關注AI題材能否支撐電子代工反彈。

板塊輪動明顯，食品金融網通領漲，半導體電子降溫，外資分歧，技術多空交織，宜精選操作。

ai_commentary_en.summary:
Financials and telecom sectors show resilience with foreign buying, while semiconductors and electronic components face heavy foreign selling and technical deterioration. Major tech leaders TSMC, MediaTek, and Delta exhibit bearish momentum despite long-term uptrends. Financial holdings Fubon and Cathay maintain strong trend structures. Market bifurcation persists as AI supply chain names correct sharply.

Taiwan market shows sector divergence: financial holdings lead with five hitting record highs on sustained foreign inflows, while technology splits — Quanta sees institutional accumulation despite bearish momentum, UMC faces aggressive foreign and trust distribution amid NVIDIA packaging optimism, and Yageo collapses on heavy selling. Chunghwa Telecom spikes to overbought levels on AI subsidiary news. Broad caution advised as half the semiconductor complex trends cold.

Taiwan market shows sector divergence: food/beverage and financials lead gains with foreign inflows, while semiconductors, electronic components and petrochemicals decline sharply on heavy foreign selling. Semis see -205k foreign net sell, components -81k, petrochemicals -59k. Financials attract +78k foreign buy. Tech weakness contrasts financial strength, suggesting rotation from AI hardware to domestic demand and rate-sensitive sectors.

Taiwan financials lead as four state-owned investment trusts merge, with Mega Financial and Hua Nan hitting highs on record profits. Tech splits: AI server supply chain attracts foreign buying, while power supply and PCB correct despite strong fundamentals. Semiconductors see heavy foreign selling.

Taiwan equity mixed: financials and telecom lead on institutional accumulation and merger catalysts, while semiconductors and shipping diverge on AI capacity news versus seasonal freight dynamics.

Taiwan market shows sector rotation with financials, steel, and AI supply chain attracting foreign buying while semiconductors and PCB face distribution. Key names diverge: 2002, 4938 accumulate; 2313, 2337 distribute; 1590, 6515 oversold but trending down.

Sector rotation favors defensives: food/retail, financials, telecom, and shipping warm while semiconductors, optoelectronics, and petrochemicals lead declines. Foreign capital rotates from tech into yield plays. Mixed technical signals prevail — overbought financials, oversold chip names, and shipping caught between strong fundamentals and chip-distribution headwinds.

Market shows sector rotation from semiconductors and electronic components (foreign selling -286K shares) toward financials, food, and telecom AI. Foreign capital favors traditional sectors while tech faces pressure. Mixed breadth with 58% of sectors in cool/cold territory.

The Taiwan market shows sector rotation with food/finance/telecom leading while semiconductors/electronics lag. Foreign capital rotates out of chips into financials and defensive sectors. Technical divergence appears across major indices with selective opportunities in data center, optical, and domestic demand plays.

Defensive sectors lead as food and financials attract foreign buying, while semiconductors and electronics face heavy foreign selling. ETF sector sees significant outflow. 0050 trades below key moving averages with bearish momentum and institutional distribution, warranting caution despite long-term uptrend intact.
